name: OSVID Bond Glue Heavy-Duty
description: Premium industrial grade adhesive formulated with high-strength synthetic polymers. Engineered for exceptional tensile bonding strength across concrete, timber, ceramic tiles, and industrial composite panels.
features: Ultra-high tensile bond strength (> 2.5 MPa)
Fast setting with extended open workability time
Resistant to high humidity, moisture, and thermal cycling
Formulated for heavy pedestrian and vehicular traffic areas

name: OSVID Tile Master Pro Adhesive
description: High-performance polymer-fortified tile adhesive formulated for vitrified, porcelain, granite, and marble tiles on internal and external wall and floor surfaces.
features: No vertical slip with excellent grab
Suitable for large format porcelain & vitrified tiles
Superior flexibility accommodating substrate movement
Waterproof formulation ideal for wet areas

name: OSVID EpoxShield 3D Floor Resin
description: Two-component, 100% solids, clear epoxy resin system engineered for seamless metallic, decorative 3D, and heavy-duty industrial floor coating with crystal clarity and mirror finish.
features: Ultra-clear, non-yellowing UV-resistant formulation
Self-leveling properties for seamless high-gloss mirror finish
High chemical, solvent, and abrasive mechanical resistance
Zero VOC, low odor, food-grade facility compliant

name: OSVID AquaBlock Elastomeric Waterproof Sealant
description: Advanced two-part polymer-modified flexible cementitious waterproof coating designed for retaining walls, basements, balconies, water reservoirs, and concrete roofs.
features: Withstands positive and negative hydrostatic pressure
Elastomeric crack-bridging capability up to 2mm
Seamless and monolithic membrane barrier
Non-toxic, safe for potable water reservoirs

name: OSVID PlastCrete Superplasticizer Admixture
description: Third-generation polycarboxylate ether (PCE) based superplasticizer formulated to achieve high early compressive strength and exceptional workability in ready-mix concrete.
features: Up to 35% water reduction without slump loss
Significantly accelerates early 24-hour and 28-day concrete strength
Improves concrete impermeability and surface finish
Chloride-free formulation protecting reinforcing rebar steel

name: OSVID Tile Grout Premium Anti-Fungal
description: Premium water-repellent cementitious tile joint filler enriched with biocide additives to resist mould, bacterial growth, and efflorescence in joint widths 1-6mm.
features: Anti-fungal, anti-mould formula for hygienic wet areas
Hydrophobic water-drop beading effect
Non-shrink, non-cracking smooth joint finish
Wide color stability under continuous sunlight exposure
